lesson: QA worker claude CLI (UI specialization) failed to progress past STANDBY on two spawn attempts (~25min). When a QA worker is stuck, respawn once, then fall back to self-grading by reading source/tests on the PR branch.

Generic QA worker prompts (qa-worker-N-prompt.md) point workers at the hive-manager web app via auth-bypass URL. For VisionClaw (native Android/Kotlin) milestones, API and A11Y workers grade the wrong surface. Evaluator must self-grade against the PR branch (git show feat/...:path) or the session must customize prompts to point at :app:testDebugUnitTest + source review.

Phase 2 M2.1 contract item 'Send it to him works across >=3 turns' has no dedicated behavioral integration test; coverage is inferred from entity-prune + context-refresh unit tests. Add a multi-turn integration test to close the gap.

Worker-8 ran :app:testDebugUnitTest green only after copying Secrets.kt.example -> Secrets.kt locally. CI must either supply Secrets.kt from a secret or accept the example as a fallback, otherwise reproducibility is brittle.

VisionClaw is Android/Kotlin (Meta Oakley HSTN). Milestone contracts (e.g. M2.1-M2.5: SessionStateManager, StateFlow migration, ConfirmationPolicy, PendingConfirmationCard Compose, disconnect invalidation) have no web UI surface. localhost:18800 only serves JSON API (auth/dev-login returns {auth:dev-bypass,granted:true}). UI QA worker with --chrome cannot test these; route to backend/unit-test worker that reads Kotlin sources and test outputs instead.

Corroborates qa-worker-1: Phase 2 M2.1-M2.5 criteria (SessionStateManager StateFlows, OpenClawBridge StateFlow migration, ConfirmationPolicy tiers, PendingConfirmationCard Compose composable, WebSocket disconnect invalidation, JVM unit tests) have zero browser-reachable surface. Hive manager should stop dispatching --chrome UI QA workers on Kotlin/Compose milestones; dispatch a ./gradlew test worker instead. Auth-bypass URL on :18800 is JSON-only.

insight: Structured tool kill switches must rewrite send_message/set_reminder/capture_task into execute-style task payloads before routing; otherwise the generic fallback path sees no task/query args and fails validation. For undo, storing execute-compatible payloads plus an internal _operatorUndo marker lets the router dispatch compensating actions through the same bridge path without re-triggering destructive confirmation tiers.

insight: Mode-driven Gemini restarts should recycle only the Gemini transport, not the whole session state, otherwise pending confirmations disappear and the effective response mode immediately loosens again.
